thread:
maria_finance: Hey team — AcmeHealth flagged their Q1 invoice (INV-67890). They say the Private deployment platform fee was doubled after the migration addendum. Can someone pull the billing breakdown?

sam_sales: I forwarded their note. They attached a screenshot but not the contract amendment. they say it moved from 'platform fee 10% of committed' to a flat $12k/mo overnight.

oliver_custsuccess: Ack — I chatted with their ops lead. They thought the migration would keep the original % fee during the 90-day onboarding window. billing-bot: Automated note: Invoice INV-67890 generated for customer AcmeHealth; total_due: $128,450; lines: ["Dedicated GPU commit: $100,000","Platform fee: $24,000","Support (Premier): $4,450"].

maria_finance: Can we confirm which pricing rule was applied? @tara_revenueops do we have an executed amendment for the flat platform fee?

tara_revenueops: I'm pulling contracts now. There's a signed amendment (AMND-3321) that references a 'transitional platform fee' but it's ambiguous. The clause: "During migration window, platform fee shall be as set forth in Schedule B." Schedule B is missing from the scanned doc.

sam_sales: Uh. Sales copy shows Schedule B as a placeholder with variable {PLATFORM_FEE}. We should not have invoiced without a concrete value.

maria_finance: Agreed. We need to avoid billing disputes. Action items: 1) pause collection on INV-67890, 2) open a support credit hold, 3) find the negotiated value (percent vs flat) and correct invoice if needed.

oliver_custsuccess: Customer asked for an immediate credit while we resolve. They proposed reversing the platform fee line until we can provide the schedule.

tara_revenueops: Found email thread dated two weeks ago where AMND-3321 was edited. Product ops inserted: "Platform fee: flat USD 12,000 per month for 6 months" but it was not initialed by legal. No signature on that page.

maria_finance: That means no executed flat fee. Per policy, we default to the master SOW which uses 10% of committed spend. For this invoice that would be $10,000, not $24,000.

billing-bot: Quick calc snippet: 
```
committed_spend = 100000
platform_pct = 0.10
platform_fee_expected = committed_spend * platform_pct  # $10,000
```

sam_sales: Customer is fine with the 10% if we credit the overcharge. They'll sign the amendment if we want the flat fee moving forward but need the credit now.

maria_finance: Ok. I'll create a credit memo for $14,000 to reduce the platform fee line from $24k -> $10k and update the invoice to INV-67890-R1. Pls confirm routing: do we need CFO approval for a credit > $10k?

tara_revenueops: Yes — credits above $10k need dual signoff per the finance policy. I'll route to legal to confirm no retroactive acceptance of the unsigned schedule.

oliver_custsuccess: Noted. I'll tell AcmeHealth we started a credit hold and expect a corrected invoice within 48 hours.

maria_finance: Drafting the credit memo now. @sam_sales can you get the customer to acknowledge in writing that adjusted invoice is acceptable so we avoid future disputes?

sam_sales: On it — will ping their CFO and add the amended draft.

billing-bot: Reminder: update collection status to 'On Hold - Billing Dispute' to prevent dunning while credit is processed.

maria_finance: Done. I'll post the credit memo ID here once created. Thanks all.

oliver_custsuccess: 👍 customer thanked us for quick turnaround.

maria_finance: Credit memo created: CM-3344 for $14,000. Invoice updated to INV-67890-R1. Leaving thread open until legal confirms the amendment signature status.

 tara_revenueops: Legal confirms unsigned Schedule B -> not binding. Closing the dispute: proceed with credit; sales to re-execute amendment if they want flat fee.

maria_finance: Closing loop. Marking collection status to 'Filed - Resolved'. We'll monitor for any downstream revenue recognition adjustments.

oliver_custsuccess: Closing on customer side. Thanks team :tada:
